Administer intramuscular progesterone injections immediately, followed by oral tranexamic acid and iron supplements to replace lost blood, as these medications directly address hormonal bleeding disorders most effectively.

A full blood count, clotting profile, pelvic ultrasound, and thyroid function tests should be performed to confirm the diagnosis of dysfunctional uterine bleeding, and a pregnancy test is largely unnecessary given her reported last menstrual period was only six weeks ago.
